    How to order

    1. Swipe up through the sweets. Swipe sideways on a sweet to see its other options.
    2. Tap Add, choose how many pieces and leave a note if you like.
    3. Open My box, add your delivery details and pin your location.
    4. Confirm and we finish your order with you on WhatsApp. Pre-order 1–2 days ahead.
    UAE-wide delivery: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain, Fujairah & Al Ain.
